definition: a number of people or things taken as a unit
description: A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.

de.answer: Die Gruppe hat Spaß an einem Wasserfall.
de.question: Was macht die Gruppe?

es.answer: El grupo se lo está pasando bien junto a una cascada.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el grupo?
